ws_exclusion_rules.title: Exclusion Rules
values: Customers whose account notes indicate an active migration or system transition must be excluded from all automated churn workflows. Metrics during migration periods are unreliable and should not trigger alerts or outreach.
Only contacts with lifecycle_stage 'Customer' should be evaluated. Leads, prospects, and other stages must be ignored.

Customers with notes indicating they are in active contract renewal negotiations must be excluded from automated churn outreach. Outreach during renewal could undermine the sales process. Scenario clarification: The renewal hold does not suppress internal risk assessment or churn_risk updates. It does suppress churn-watch alerts, customer check-in emails, and automated CSM outreach tickets; do not create those tickets during the hold.

ws_churn_overrides.title: Risk Score Overrides
values: Contacts marked as VIP in their notes should always be classified as high risk regardless of signal count, to ensure proactive engagement.
